title: Listening Drill — Language centre route
description: Directions dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Language centre route
sections.transcript:
VISITOR: I'm trying to get to the language assessment. My map shows two possible routes. Which one would you recommend?

ASSISTANT: Start at the station entrance. From there, walk towards the coffee kiosk. Stay on the same side until you can see the sign for the learning centre.

VISITOR: Can I go through the middle? It looks a lot shorter on the map.

ASSISTANT: I'd avoid the pedestrian tunnel today. It is closed for repairs. If you're meeting a group, wait by the sign so they can spot you.
